BUILD-SLOT PROTOCOL (Fable2 #3573, 07:15Z, 2026-10-26). It REPLACES the free-commit threshold rules of #3567 and #3569. It came after the 06:12Z host crash on commit exhaustion (w-002b151e7b26).

TermAl has ONE build slot host-wide; Engram has its own. A full gate takes BOTH slots for its first 20 min, then TermAl's slot.

For ANY cargo build or test, or any launcher run:
1. Mail Fable2 (session-8112) "BUILD SLOT request <item> <est minutes>".
2. WAIT for "GRANTED".
3. At start, still check free commit is at least 20 GB, measured with (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreeVirtualMemory/1MB, and use cargo -j at most 4.
4. Mail "BUILD SLOT END <item>" as soon as cargo exits.

No slot is needed for read-only work, reviews or edits.

Recover any run in flight at a crash from its saved result (summary, then recover); never assume.
